svg.title: alex karp has been doing the same bit for years
svg.desc: Alex Karp's official Palantir portrait beside three documented public versions of his recurring contrast between working software and PowerPoint, golf, and conventional enterprise salesmanship.
svg.text: alex karp has been doing the same bit for years.
the repetition is the culture: working software is the sales deck.
“what we do do is we play software.”
three public, documentable versions · no claim that these are the only times he has used the refrain
portrait: palantir official executive-management page · quotes: linked sources in the essay caption
